Home.heroHeadline: Certified Translation & Localization, Delivered With Precision
Home.heroDefinition: JUSOR (جسور) is an internationally accredited translation and localization company providing certified document translation, business localization, and interpretation services across 60+ language pairs. Backed by ISO 17100-certified linguists and embassy-recognized certification, JUSOR delivers legal, medical, and technical translations with turnaround options from 4 hours to 72 hours, serving individuals, enterprises, and government institutions worldwide.

Company.aboutSubtitle: A certified legal and business translation office serving Dubai and the UAE.
Company.valueAccuracyBody: Every translation passes through a multi-stage review process before delivery — no shortcuts on precision.
Company.valueConfidentialityBody: Client documents are handled under strict data-security protocols and signed NDAs where required.
Company.valueComplianceBody: Our certified translations are accepted by embassies, courts, ministries, and regulators across the UAE.
Company.valueSpeedBody: From 4-hour express service to standard 24-hour delivery, we keep your deadlines on track.
Company.certificationsBody: Our linguists follow ISO 17100-aligned quality processes and are licensed to prepare certified translations accepted by UAE government authorities.
Company.ctaBannerTitle: Ready to work with a certified translation partner?
Company.officesSubtitle: Visit us or reach out — our team is based in Dubai and serves clients across the UAE.
Company.careersSubtitle: We're always looking for certified linguists and project managers who share our commitment to accuracy and confidentiality.
Company.vettingStep1Body: We review your credentials, certifications, and language pair specializations.
Company.vettingStep2Body: Candidates complete a formal assessment of source and target language competency.
Company.vettingStep3Body: A graded sample translation in your specialization area (legal, medical, technical, etc.).
Company.vettingStep4Body: A conversation with our project management team about your experience and availability.
Company.vettingStep5Body: We verify certifications and, where applicable, Ministry of Justice licensing before onboarding.
Company.careersCtaBody: Send your CV and a brief note about your specialization to our team — we review every application.
Company.contactSubtitle: Questions about a project, pricing, or turnaround? Reach out — we typically respond within one business hour.
Company.formSuccessBody: Thank you for reaching out — our team will get back to you within one business hour during office hours.
